cq: Which transactions are flagged as fraudulent?
sparql:
PREFIX eli: <http://data.europa.eu/eli/ontology#>
PREFIX geo1: <http://www.w3.org/2003/01/geo/wgs84_pos#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX schema: <http://schema.org/>

ASK {
  ?transaction a ex:CreditCardTransaction ;
               ex:isFraud true .
}
diagnosis:
ASK returned false. Missing: ?transaction a ex:CreditCardTransaction ;
               ex:isFraud true .

cq: Which cardholders have made more than 3 fraudulent transactions?
sparql:
PREFIX eli: <http://data.europa.eu/eli/ontology#>
PREFIX geo1: <http://www.w3.org/2003/01/geo/wgs84_pos#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX schema: <http://schema.org/>

ASK {
  ?cardholder a schema:Person ;
              schema:madeBy ?transaction .
  FILTER(?transaction > 3)
}

cq: What is the total amount involved in fraudulent transactions per merchant category?
What is the job and date of birth of the cardholder who made a given transaction?
Which cardholders live in a city with a population greater than 100,000?
sparql:
PREFIX eli: <http://data.europa.eu/eli/ontology#>
PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/>
PREFIX geo1: <http://www.w3.org/2003/01/geo/wgs84_pos#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX schema: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

ASK {
  ?cardholder a schema:Person ;
              schema:address ?address .
  ?address schema:addressLocality ?city ;
           schema:population ?population .
  FILTER(?population > 100000)
}

cq: Which merchants have the highest number of fraud-flagged transactions?
What merchant categories are most associated with fraud?
Which transactions occurred where the cardholder's location and merchant location are more than 50km apart?
Which fraudulent transactions happened in a specific US state (e.g., SC)?
How many transactions occurred within the same hour across all cardholders?
sparql:
PREFIX eli: <http://data.europa.eu/eli/ontology#>
PREFIX geo1: <http://www.w3.org/2003/01/geo/wgs84_pos#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX schema: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

ASK {
  ?transaction1 a ex:CreditCardTransaction ;
                 ex:transactionDateTime ?dateTime1 .
  ?transaction2 a ex:CreditCardTransaction ;
                 ex:transactionDateTime ?dateTime2 .
  FILTER(?transaction1 != ?transaction2)
  FILTER(FLOOR(?dateTime1 / 3600) = FLOOR(?dateTime2 / 3600))
}
